scripts.start: npm --prefix backend-ts run build && node backend-ts/dist/index.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend-ts && npm run test:frontend
scripts.fix: npm run fix:frontend && npm run fix:backend-ts
scripts.fix:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
